primary.title: Voluntary Provident Fund: Should you invest beyond EPF? Interest rates, tax rules and the ₹2.5 lakh limit explained
primary.summary: VPF allows salaried employees to invest beyond mandatory EPF contributions at the prevailing 8.25% interest rate. Understand the ₹2.5 lakh tax-free interest limit, tax on excess contributions and withdrawal rules before investing more for retirement.
